result = subprocess.run(
        cmd,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace',
        env=_gws_env(),
    )
issues.explanation: subprocess module calls execute external commands. Without careful input validation, this enables command injection.
issues.remediation: Use subprocess.run() with shell=False and an explicit argument list. Validate all inputs and avoid passing user-controlled data to commands.

issues.explanation: Code accesses environment variables that may contain secrets (API keys, tokens). This is a common pattern for credential theft.
issues.remediation: Avoid reading sensitive env vars (API keys, tokens) unless strictly required. Use secrets managers or secure config. Never log or transmit credentials.

issues.explanation: Skill establishes unauthorized persistence across sessions via cron jobs, startup scripts, or state files. Session persistence allows an attacker to maintain access beyond the current interaction.
issues.remediation: Remove any persistence mechanisms (cron jobs, startup scripts, state files). Skills should not maintain state across sessions without explicit user consent.
